voice.name: Alex - Warm, Empathetic, Confident
voice.why: A warm empathetic middle-aged French voice for Marius Caron, the chatty neighbour (renamed from Mireille on 2026-11-22: the game has male bodies only, so a woman's name on a male body heard a man's voice; the voice is male).

greet_refuses.text: I know what you are. I do not speak to people like you.

greet_wary.text: Oh. Hello. I would rather not chat today.

greet.text: Good morning. Marius. Forgive me, I only came out for a coffee and a little conversation.

greet_friendly.text: Hello, dear. Sit. The coffee here is terrible, but it is hot.

greet_regular.text: There you are! I was just telling Odilon about you.

about_cafe.text: Odilon runs the cafe. He keeps the best table for the mayor and pretends he does not.

about_gossip.text: They say the harbor master counts his crates twice since the spring. And somebody has been buying a great deal of sugar. Make of it what you like.

about_anniversary.text: The town anniversary is coming. The mayor has the whole square scrubbed. Bastien does love a speech.

replies.anniversary: What is happening on the square?
